ColonyCouncil.QuirkDef.label: makes the first pot
ColonyCouncil.QuirkDef.effect: takes a cup of coffee or tea to a friend in the morning

plain.li: I'm up before the others anyway, so I've started taking a cup round to whoever's about. It's a good way to start the day.
[winter] Cold mornings want something hot. I take a cup to someone before the day gets going.

warm.li: There's nothing like handing someone their first cup of the day and watching them wake up into it.

cheerful.li: First pot of the day is mine now! I take a cup to a friend and we start the morning right.

blunt.li: I'm up first. I make the pot. Someone gets a cup.

gloomy.li: Mornings are long when you're up before everyone. Taking someone a cup gives me something to do with them.

cold.li: I take a cup to whoever is awake. People work better with something hot in them.

plain.li: I haven't taken anyone their morning cup in a while. People fetch their own now.

warm.li: I miss the morning cups. Maybe I'll start again when the mornings are quieter.

blunt.li: Stopped making the first pot. People have legs.

cheerful.li: Someone else can make the first pot for a while!

gloomy.li: Nobody's had a cup from me in weeks. I don't think they noticed.

cold.li: I've stopped the morning cups. It took time I could use better.
